name: verify-subscribe
description: Model-check how a lite-07 subscription accounts for each group (`rs/moq-net/src/lite/publisher.rs` `TrackRun` and `GroupServe`, `lite/subscriber.rs` `ServeLoop::apply_response`, `src/tail.rs`) with TLA+. Use when a change touches SUBSCRIBE_DROP, SUBSCRIBE_SKIP, stale (OLD) drops, which groups a publisher serves or names once, Group Stream resets, preemption, and expiry (a stream reset with OLD when its group expires, even after its FIN), a GROUP's Previous Start and the skips it passes over or the publisher holds back for it, or the subscriber's tail, or when a drop bug needs every ordering of the Subscribe Stream against the Group Streams checked.
